newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent futures boosted by NYMEX expiry.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent futures boosted by NYMEX expiry.

text.p: IPE Brent crude oil futures recovered from their early losses on Thursday, buoyed up by short-covering on the NYMEX ahead of the January crude contract expiry, brokers said.
Having touched a low of $23.67 per barrel, February Brent climbed up to $23.95 per barrel by 1505 GMT, three cents above Wednesday's settlement.
Brokers reported little fundamental news to explain the moves: "This morning London was dead as a dodo. I think this has got something to do with the expiry of January WTI."
But physical demand was sketchy and the crack spread weak, traders said.
January gas oil gained $2.00 to $221.25 per tonne.
